notes.title: Routastic event is coming! 🔥
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 👋

We're excited to announce that our friends at DRAGO entertainment will be hosting a thrilling event for all you adventure seekers out there on April 26th! The event will feature huge discounts, and we're thrilled to be a part of this Routastic event as well. 

[h3][b]Pre-sale Giveaways[/b][/h3]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1052490530489114645/1096043354506149988/franchise_event_giveaways.jpg[/img]

We can't wait to see all of you in action during the Routastic Event. 
Mark those dates in the calendar and get ready for an unforgettable adventure!

You can also check the highly anticipated Gas Station Simulator - Airstrip DLC will launch on the same day as the event. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137370/Gas_Station_Simulator__Airstrip_DLC/

Thank you for your continued support, and we'll see you in the game!
